competences.description: Shoots a fire arrow at the enemy. The damage increases by 10% for each harmful effect.

effets.description: Increases damage per debuff on the target

competences.description: Burns enemies with a fire shower 3 to 5 times, inflicting Continuous Damage for 3 turns with a 35% chance and increases the enemy's skill cooldown time by 1 turn with a 10% chance each.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
